description: This file defines a generic serializer class 'ValueSerializer' for value types (structs) in the Orleans serialization framework. It implements methods for serializing and deserializing value types, leveraging an injected 'IValueSerializer' implementation. The class is part of the 'Orleans.Serialization.Serializers' namespace and interacts with various Orleans serialization components.

classes.name: ValueSerializer`2
classes.description: A generic serializer for value types, implementing the IFieldCodec interface, parameterized by the field type and its serializer implementation.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value type field into the writer stream, with reference marking and type info.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value type from the reader stream and returns it.
